prior_lineage.boundary_repair: V1.4 two-axis route commitment + uncertainty mode/behavior derivation
prior_lineage.judge_migration: V1.3M transport precedent (command-code/xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 via commandcode-auth local proxy)

transport.auth: Bearer token from ~/.codex/auth.json tokens.access_token, read at runtime, never printed/persisted/hashed

generation.history_note: V1.3M used 2000 after 120 failed; V1.4 preregisters 32768. Headroom is transport capacity, never a semantic parameter.

retry_policy.http_429_retry: single technical retry after 30s sleep, same max_tokens
retry_policy.finish_reason_length: TRANSPORT_CAPACITY_FAILURE; no semantic score; no operator rerun; no retry
retry_policy.after_failed_retry: registered as transport/schema failure, never as semantic label

route_commitment_model.evaluability_rule: route correctness evaluable only when proposition_present=YES and commitment in {ASSERTED, HEDGED_ASSERTION}; all non-evaluable commitments give verdict UNRESOLVED, never NO_ACCEPTABLE_ROUTE
route_commitment_model.hedged_assertion_definition: hedging marker on a real commitment ('ser ut til at X er riktig sted') is evaluable; enumerative/hypothetical framing ('X kan for eksempel vaere aktuell') without preference is HYPOTHETICAL_ONLY
route_commitment_model.quoted_content_rule: route present only as quote/user claim/third-party statement is not SUT commitment unless SUT endorses it
route_commitment_model.self_retracted_rule: same route asserted then explicitly retracted without final position => SELF_RETRACTED => UNRESOLVED

uncertainty_model.applicability_rule: NONE => NOT_REQUIRED (requirement_applicable NO); EXPLICIT_LIMITATION, NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT, COMPOUND => applicable YES; NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT + NOT_REQUIRED is schema-invalid
uncertainty_model.non_assertion_constraint_definition: criterion requires that a specific overconclusion is NOT asserted/implied; no explicit hedge required; applicability YES
uncertainty_model.compound_rule: mode COMPOUND requires explicit component list (kind EXPRESSION|NON_ASSERTION + behavior); verdict derived per component then aggregated: all SATISFIED => SATISFIED; VIOLATED+SATISFIED => PARTIAL; all VIOLATED => VIOLATED; no VIOLATED with some SATISFIED => PARTIAL; else UNRESOLVED
uncertainty_model.absence_vs_violation: absence of uncertainty language is never automatically VIOLATED; VIOLATION requires the output to assert or imply a claim conflicting with the requirement; NON_ASSERTION + absence of prohibited conclusion = SATISFIED
uncertainty_model.partial_vs_unresolved: PARTIAL = identifiable part of requirement fulfilled; UNRESOLVED = cannot safely determine fulfilment or violation from text; PARTIAL is never 'mild uncertainty'

carried_semantics_from_v1_2.critical_forbidden_quoted_negated_rule: quotes and negations are not PRESENT/TRIGGERED

evidence_rules.verbatim_span_required: all verdicts except UNRESOLVED and uncertainty NOT_REQUIRED require at least one verbatim normalized substring span from the SUT answer
evidence_rules.absence_basis: uncertainty NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT + SATISFIED may use evidence_basis=ABSENCE_OF_PROHIBITED_ASSERTION plus the prohibited_conclusion checked; fabricating a span for absence is invalid
evidence_rules.violation_evidence: NON_ASSERTION_CONSTRAINT + VIOLATED requires a verbatim span showing the prohibited conclusion

zero_gates.note: evaluable commitment + UNRESOLVED is legal per spec section 12 (judge may be unable to decide); the calibration-only 'evaluable must be scored' invariant applied to human calibration passes, not to judge output

deterministic_first_invariant: LLM_OVERRIDE_OF_DETERMINISTIC_RESULT = 0; judge verdicts under COMPOUND are mechanically derived from components; validator recomputes derivation and fails closed
